title: Introduce token-slice exporter and inference observability playground
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds an opt-in token-slice exporter and a developer-facing Observability Playground UI. New Grafana panels for token-slice exploration, energy sparkline, and queue-lag cohorts. Tuned SLO alert damping for bursty token-slice patterns.
description: Motivation: Users asked for a low-friction way to iterate on token-level cost/latency signals and validate alerting changes without flooding production dashboards. This PR introduces a developer-facing "Observability Playground" (opt-in) plus a data export called the Token Slice Exporter (v0.1) that emits compact, folded token-level slices for downstream dashboards and interactive analysis. Main changes: 1) Token Slice Exporter: a service that subscribes to sampled invocation spans, extracts per-stage timing (frontend, routing, kernel-queue, kernel-exec, kv-cache, postprocess), token counts, estimated per-stage energy proxy, and a compact prompt-shape fingerprint. To control cardinality we introduce "folded slices" which hash prompt-shape + stage sequence and emit counts/quantiles instead of raw high-cardinality labels. Export format is a simple NDJSON line per slice (schema v0.1) and a rolling aggregation path (v0.1-rollup) that supports windowed counters. 2) Observability Playground UI: a small React app available under /observability/playground (internal auth only) that lets engineers query token slices, pivot by prompt shape fingerprint, build ad-hoc cohorts, and export CSV for evaluation. 3) Dashboards: new Grafana panels added under Observability > Playground: Token Slice Explorer, Queue-Lag Cohorts, Energy Sparkline, and Folded-Slice Heatmap. 4) Alert tuning: SLO alert rule adjustments to de-weight transient burst events identified by the folded-slice fingerprint; added an alert damping adapter that suppresses duplicate alerts for the same folded-slice for a sliding 10-minute window. 5) Config & ops: feature flag telemetry.playground.enabled (default: false), documentation page with runbook and data retention notes, and e2e replay test that verifies exporter stability with synthetic real-world traces. Checklist: - [x] Implement exporter service + ingestion pipeline - [x] Add folded-slice hashing & rollup logic - [x] Add React Playground UI + internal route and auth gating - [x] Grafana dashboard panels and JSON models - [x] Unit + integration tests + e2e replay harness - [x] Docs + runbook updates - [x] Performance bench (small-scale) Summary of commits: - Add token-slice exporter, schema v0.1 and rollup worker - Instrument span hydrator to emit slice candidates - Folded-slice hashing implementation with coarse quantiles - Playground UI: query layer, results table, CSV export - Grafana: panels and dashboard JSONs - Alerting: add damping adapter and SLO rule tweaks - Tests: unit, integration, end-to-end replay - Docs: observability/playground.md and runbook Note on performance: Exporter runs as a separate opt-in service and consumes only sampled traces (default 0.5% sampling). Benchmarks run in this branch showed ~5% CPU overhead on a sample ingest node at 0.5% sampling and 2.3% memory overhead for the rollup worker under steady-state. We intentionally kept raw labels folded to avoid high-cardinality index growth. Changed areas (high-level): - telemetry/exporter/token_slice_exporter.py - telemetry/rollup/folded_slice_worker.py - runtime/span_hydrator/emit_slice_candidates.go - observability/ui/playground/* (React app) - docs/observability/playground.md - infra/grafana/dashboards/playground_token_slices.json - alerts/slo/token-slice-damping-rules.yaml - tests/e2e/replay/token_slice_replay_test.go - scripts/bench/token_slice_bench.sh Review notes & conversation: Reviewer (Ethan Brooks): "Nice shape — main concern is cardinality growth if teams enable this widely. Can we make folding stricter by default and add a sampling knob per-tenant?" Author (Maya Chen): "Agree — implemented tenant-level sampling in config and added an aggressive default fold (prompt-shape + stage seq -> sha1 -> 16-bit) with a feature flag to relax for experiments. See telemetry/rollup/folded_slice_worker.py for the parameterized window." Reviewer (Priya Rao): "Alert damping adapter looks promising but I'd like an integration test showing alerts suppressed for repeated folded-slice bursts." Author: "Added tests/e2e/replay/token_slice_replay_test.go which replays synthetic bursts and asserts damping behavior; locally CI showed suppression as expected." Reviewer (Arjun Patel): "The UI needs an obvious opt-out and data retention note in the runbook." Author: "Added a prominent banner in the UI and documented retention/config in docs/observability/playground.md." CI & checks: - CI run 1: unit tests failed (timeout in replay harness) - CI run 2: flaky e2e fixed, all tests passed - Lint: minor style warnings fixed - Bench: scripts run in pipeline with smoke metrics All checks passing on merge. Merge outcome: Merged via squash on 2026-02-25. Follow-ups: - ENG-9052: telemetry: expose per-tenant sampling control in Console UI - ENG-8421: observability: add persisted fold-key index for retrospective joins - PERF-OPEN: run a 24h production pilot at 0.1% sampling before enabling org-wide.
